user.title: Coolblue Energy
user.description: Enter your Coolblue account credentials. Initial import might take a while.

data_description.email: The email address of your Coolblue webshop account — the same one you use on coolblue.nl, not something specific to energy.
data_description.password: The password of that same Coolblue account. It is stored so the integration can log in again on every poll.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Coolblue Energy
reauth_confirm.description: Coolblue no longer accepts the stored password. Please re-enter it.

data_description.password: The current password of your Coolblue account {email}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Coolblue Energy. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Coolblue account is already configured.

reimport_statistics.name: Reimport hourly statistics
reimport_statistics.description: Force a full reimport of hourly electricity and gas statistics from the Coolblue Energy API starting from the given date up to and including yesterday. Existing recorder data for the range is overwritten and cumulative sums are recalculated, which fixes gaps, negative spikes, or other artefacts in the Energy Dashboard.

config_entry_id.name: Debtor
config_entry_id.description: Which Coolblue Energy debtor to reimport. Required: a reimport overwrites stored history, so it always names the debtor it acts on.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day to reimport (inclusive). All days through yesterday will be fetched from the API and written to the recorder.
